Row |drop=Matcha Dye |quantity=1 |requirement= |odds=RNGesus Incarnate |pool=Separate |weight=0.000004 }} |-- }} }} == Behavior == The Revenant Horror is a Zombie-type mob which is hostile towards all nearby players. It moves at a relatively fast pace and deals damage with its scythe weapon. It receives a speed boost on hit. All Revenant Horrors are immune to [[Potions|potion effects]]. They are immune to [[Bows|arrows]]; when hit by them, they heal. They are immune to the item abilities of [[Aspect of the Dragons]] and [[Ice Spray Wand]]. As with all Slayer bosses, if the Revenant Horror has not dealt damage to a player for some time, it will begin rapidly regenerating [[health]]. The regeneration immediately stops when it hits a player again. Additionally, if either it or its target stays in the same block for too long, it performs a slam-dunk attack, knocking the target towards it and dealing {{Stat|tdmg}}. If 3 minutes pass without the boss being defeated, it will despawn, failing the Slayer quest. A timer is shown above its head indicating the remaining time. If the Revenant Horror enters the Village area, it will immediately despawn and the Slayer quest will be failed. {{SlayerTier|1}} through {{SlayerTier|4}} Revenant Horror have all the abilities of the tiers below them. {| class="wikitable" !Tier !{{stat|hp}} !{{stat|dmg}} ! colspan="2" |Ability !Slayer XP Reward |- | class="ct" |{{SlayerTier|I|romanonly=yes}} |500 |15 |'''Life Drain''' |Drains {{stat|hp}} every few seconds | class="ct" |5 XP |- | class="ct" |{{SlayerTier|II|romanonly=yes}} |20k |25 |'''Pestilence''' |Deals AOE damage every second, shredding armor by 25% | class="ct" |25 XP |- | class="ct" |{{SlayerTier|III|romanonly=yes}} |400k |120 |'''Enrage''' |Gets real mad once in a while | class="ct" |100 XP |- | class="ct" |{{SlayerTier|IV|romanonly=yes}} |1.5M |400 | colspan="2" |{{bc}} | class="ct" |500 XP |- | rowspan="3" class="ct" |{{SlayerTier|V|romanonly=yes}} | rowspan="3" |10M | rowspan="3" |2,400 |'''Redemption''' |Heals rapidly and is immune to magic damage. | rowspan="3" class="ct" |1500 XP |- |'''Explosive Assault''' |Throws explosive TNT. |- |'''Thermonuclear''' |Charges up and releases a massive explosion. |} === {{SlayerTier|3}} and {{SlayerTier|4}} === After 40 seconds, it will enter a "Mad" state, in which its behavior is not changed. After another 5 seconds, it will enter an "Enraged" state, in which it moves slightly faster and deals highly increased amounts of damage. This enraged state lasts for 12 seconds. === {{SlayerTier|5}} (Atoned Horror) === The {{SlayerTier|5}} boss is much different from the bosses preceding it. It has a different appearance and is named "Atoned Horror" instead of "Revenant Horror". It is also immune to all types of ability damage, [[Wither Skeleton Pet]]'s Death's Touch ability, as well as damage from [[Bonemerang]]. It has a natural regeneration effect, which heals for 1/1000 of its maximum health(10,000 {{stat|health}} normally, 20,000 {{stat|health}} with [[Derpy|Mayor Derpy]]) per second. Every second, a circle will appear beneath its target's feet similar to the [[Gaia Construct]], but made of different blocks and larger in size. The center is red and progresses to white. After a short delay, the Atoned Horror will throw a block of TNT to the center of that circle. The TNT explodes on contact with the ground, damaging enemies within the circle for a percentage of their health, depending on how close they are to the circle's center. When the player is hit by the TNT the boss heals 500,000 health. Upon reaching 1/3 health, the boss enters an enhanced stage, throwing TNT twice as often. The boss remains in this state even if it regenerates health back to above 1/3. After 30 seconds, it will stop moving and attacking, and a circle of expanding bedrock forms around its feet. A text appears above its head labeled "Boom!" and a hidden timer counts down from 5 seconds. Nearby mobs flee from the Atoned Horror when this happens. Upon reaching 0, the Atoned Horror unleashes a barrage of lightning around it, similar to [[Storm]]'s Giga Lightning, killing anything within a 7 block radius. This attack bypasses protection from the [[End Stone Sword]] and [[Mithril Coat]]. After that, it resumes attacking as before. == Minibosses == {{SlayerMiniboss}} {{/Minibosses}} == Tips == *Any of the [[Dragon Armors]] reforged to {{Reforge|Fierce}} are recommended options if the player is looking to take down a '''Revenant Horror''' {{SlayerTier|III}}. *For the '''Revenant Horror''' {{SlayerTier|4}}, using {{Item|Shadow Assassin Armor}} reforged on to {{Reforge|Ancient}} or a better armor set, and paired with a max enchanted {{Item|Reaper Falchion}} can help immensely. *It is possible to kill the {{SlayerTier |4}} or lower very quickly using a {{Mythic}} [[Guardian Pet]] with a highly intelligent Armor Set such as Necrotic [[Wise Dragon Armor]] or [[Storm's Armor]]. *If the '''Revenant Horror''' gets enraged, it is advised to run away until it reverts to its normal state. *If the player or the boss stays on the same block space for too long, it will result in the player taking {{stat|True Damage}} and massive {{stat|kb}} from the boss. This only applies to {{Stier|3}} and above, however. *Trapping the '''Revenant Horror''' in a lift in the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} can make the fight a lot easier. Additionally, spawning the boss in the {{zone|Diamond Reserve}} or {{zone|Obsidian Sanctuary}} and luring it into {{Item|Lava}} can hugely reduce the '''Revenant Horror''''s mobility and prevent it from landing hits on the player; however, it can still use Life Drain which can drain the player's {{stat|hp}} from a distance. *For {{SlayerTier|3}} or higher bosses, healing items such as Power Orbs and weapons with {{Ench|Life Steal}} or {{Ench|Drain}} are essential. *When standing at {{Coordinates|-138|42|-141}} in the {{zone|Hub Crypts}}, the {{SlayerTier|5}} {{Item|TNT}} attack cannot hit the player.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AgOASszdQro Therefore, using this spot can let players focus on {{stat|dmg}} instead of high {{stat|ehp}}. == Trivia == *The '''Atoned Horror''' was leaked by former admin {{RN|mvp+|Minikloon}}. It was shown in a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AvvP9g4P_RM stream of StudioTV]. The boss had {{Hp|3M}} and the TNT was significantly weaker. *Because it is immune to arrows, the '''Revenant Horror''' is also immune to the effects of {{Item|Voodoo Doll}} and will not be affected by the damage over time debuff. *The '''Revenant Horror''', the '''Tarantula Broodfather''' and the '''Riftstalker Bloodfiend''' are currently the only Slayer bosses to have a {{SlayerTier|5}} variant. *Under the leadership of [[Resistance Leader|Technoblade]] and [[Resistance General|FurryEBoy]], a single {{SlayerTier|5}} Revenant Horror provided enough {{Skillname|combat}} XP to immediately spawn another {{SlayerTier|5}} Revenant Horror. Players would pair up to spawn {{SlayerTier|5}} Revenant Horrors for each other. **This was possible with [[Derpy]]. It was possible to slayer trade with Svens & Tarantulas as well. Furthermore, with the addition of the [[Attributes|Veteran]] attribute after the Kuudra Revamp, this was possible even without the XP bonus from Mayors. However, this was patched in an update, which a mob gives at max 75% of the {{skill|Combat|XP}} required. *When using the [[Sentinel Warden Skin]], the boss stops changing its appearance when enraged.
